text: Had a shoulder issue for months and spent several hundred dollars having physical therapist work on me.  1 visit with Nigel and I am back to normal.  He took one look at my shoulder and told me the issue and how he was going to fix it.  Anyway, I don't write reviews... but, after looking up his address for a friend and seeing the 2 knuckleheads that wrote bad reviews -- I felt obliged to share my review and address the bad reviewers.   To the guy who could NOT afford his followup services, get a job.  1000 baht is cheap and if you know anything about chiropractor care... sometimes after an adjustment it gets worse, then the following days you feel MUCH better.   As for the second negative nelly reviewer... if you walk into a mans business and want to question his abilities, then perhaps it is best you not go.
